info.name: Walmart Cost Management Assortment Recommendations DSV Orders API
Walmart Ship One or More Purchase Order Lines

params.name: purchaseOrderId
params.description:
Specifies an identifier associated with the purchase order. This value is used to query a purchase order. Example(s):
2581154514813

params.name: shipNode
params.description:
Specifies the distribution facility distributor identifier. This parameter identifies each facility from which the inventory is requested. The identifier is autogenerated during drop ship vendor (DSV) account creation. Every time users add or update a facility in Supplier Center, a new identifier is generated. Ensure this value is up to date. Example(s):
123456701

items.docs:
POST /v3/orders/{purchaseOrderId}/shipping

POST /v3/orders/{purchaseOrderId}/cancel

This request cancels one or more order lines before an order has been fulfilled. A `purchaseOrderId` must be included to cancel an order line. Update the inventory after canceling an order. POST /v3/orders/{purchaseOrderId}/acknowledge

This request allows a drop ship vendor (DSV) to acknowledge an order, including all order lines, preferably within four hours of receipt of the order. The response to a successful call contains the acknowledged order. As a good practice, acknowledge orders to avoid underselling. params.name: shipNode
params.description:
Specifies the distribution facility distributor identifier.

This parameter identifies each facility from which the inventory is requested. 
The identifier is autogenerated during drop ship vendor (DSV) account creation. 
Every time users add or update a facility in Supplier Center, a new identifier is generated. 
Ensure this value is up to date.

Example(s):
123456701

params.name: limit
params.description:
Specifies the number of orders to be returned. The value cannot be larger than 200. Example(s):
100

params.name: sku
params.description:
Specifies the stock keeping unit (SKU) item identifier.

This identifier is specified by the drop ship vendor (DSV) and used by the vendor in the specification file to refer to each item.

The following special characters in the stock keeping unit (SKU) require encoding: ':', '/', '?', '#', '[', ']', '@', '!', '$', '&', "'", '(', ')', '*', '+', ',', ';', '=', ',', '{', and '}'. '%' requires encoding if it is part of the stock keeping unit (SKU). Encode spaces with %20. Other characters do not require encoding.

Example(s):
06194456252572

params.name: customerOrderId
params.description:
Specifies an identifier associated with the sales orders to retrieve or filter the orders. Example(s):
6101730068963

params.name: purchaseOrderId
params.description:
Specifies an identifier associated with the purchase order. This value is used to query a purchase order. Example(s):
2581154514813

params.name: status
params.description:
Specifies the status of the purchase order line. Valid values are: | Value | Meaning | | --- | --- | | Created | The purchase order line has been created. | | Acknowledged | The purchase order line has been acknowledged. | | Shipped | The purchase order line has been shipped. | | Delivered | The purchase order line has been delivered. | | Cancelled | The purchase order line has been cancelled. | Example(s):
Created

params.name: createdStartDate
params.description:
Specifies the created start date for the query. This query fetches all purchase orders created after this date. The default is the current date minus seven days. Use either UTC (yyyy-MM-dd) or ISO 8601 (yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ) formats. Example(s):
2023-03-16 2023-03-16T10:30:15Z

params.name: createdEndDate
params.description:
Specifies the created end date for the query. This query fetches all purchase orders created before this date. The default is the current date minus seven days. Use either UTC (yyyy-MM-dd) or ISO 8601 (yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ) formats. Example(s):
2023-03-19 2023-03-19T10:30:15Z

params.name: fromExpectedShipDate
params.description:
Specifies the "from" expected ship date for the query. This query fetches all purchase orders that have order lines with an expected ship date after this date. Use either UTC (yyyy-MM-dd) or ISO 8601 (yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ) formats. Example(s):
2023-03-20 2023-03-20T10:30:15Z

params.name: toExpectedShipDate
params.description:
Specifies the "to" expected ship date for the query. This query fetches all purchase orders that have order lines with an expected ship date before this date. Use either UTC (yyyy-MM-dd) or ISO 8601 (yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ) formats. Example(s):
2023-03-21 2023-03-21T10:30:15Z

params.name: productInfo
params.description:
Specifies the image URL and product weight in the response, if available. If `true`, the image URL and product weight are provided in the response. If `false`, the image URL and product weight are not provided in the response. The value defaults to `false`. Example(s):
false

items.docs:
GET /v3/orders

This request retrieves details of all the orders for specified search criteria. The search only retrieves orders created in last 180 days. A maximum of 20,000 orders can be fetched at a time. Attempting to download more than 20,000 orders will return an error.

GET /v3/orders/released

This request retrieves all the orders with line items in `Created` status. These orders have been released from the Walmart Order Management System (OMS) to the supplier for processing. Released orders are ready for supplier fulfillment. Only orders created in last 180 days can be fetched, and a maximum of 20,000 orders can be fetched and downloaded at a time.
